## **Sinclair Announces Sinclair Cares: Enriching Local Lives Year-End Special Highlighting Community Impact and Charitable Partnerships**


11.23.2026


**30-Minute Special Hosted by The National News Desk’s Angela Brown to Stream Thanksgiving Eve and Air Across Sinclair Stations in December**


**BALTIMORE – November 23, 2026** – Sinclair today announced


*Sinclair Cares: Enriching Local Lives* ,


a 30-minute special highlighting the company's charitable partnerships, community initiatives and collective efforts to make a positive impact in communities across the country throughout 2026.


Hosted by


*The National News Desk* anchor Angela Brown, the special will premiere on Sinclair's station websites on Wednesday, November 25, Thanksgiving Eve, before airing across Sinclair's television stations throughout the month of December.


A company-wide initiative, Sinclair Cares leverages the strength of Sinclair's television stations, digital platforms to support important causes and respond to community needs and natural disasters. The special,


*Sinclair Cares: Enriching Local Lives* showcases how Sinclair is making a meaningful difference in communities across the country through partnerships, volunteerism, charitable giving, and public awareness campaigns


. Through partnerships with national nonprofit organizations and engagement across Sinclair's local stations, Sinclair Cares brings together the company's employees, audiences and community partners to help make a meaningful difference.


“Enriching Local Lives is at the heart of what we do, and Sinclair Cares is an important part of how we put that commitment into action,” said Rob Weisbord, Chief Operating Officer and President of Local Media at Sinclair. “Throughout the year, our employees, stations and nonprofit partners have come together to support causes that matter to the communities we serve. This special is an opportunity to reflect on those efforts, recognize the organizations doing incredible work and thank everyone who has helped us make a difference.”


Each year, Sinclair Cares leverages the company's extensive broadcast and digital platforms to support charitable organizations, raise awareness of important causes, and inspire audiences to get involved. The special will revisit these efforts and celebrate the impact of partnerships that extend Sinclair's commitment to community service.


The special will stream on November 25 on Sinclair's station websites


(between 8-10pm ET).


Broadcast dates and times will vary by market throughout December (check local listings).


**About Sinclair**


Sinclair, Inc. is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 181 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; and owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts, and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at


[www.sbgi.net](http://www.sbgi.net/) .


**About Sinclair Cares**


Sinclair Cares utilizes the strength of Sinclair Inc.’s properties to uplift organizations and inspire audiences and employees to make a positive impact in their communities. A company-wide initiative, Sinclair Cares mobilizes Sinclair’s assets to support various community and charitable endeavors through financial assistance, volunteerism and raising awareness of important topics through Sinclair’s media platforms. Recent partnerships include Feeding America, The American Red Cross, The Salvation Army, American Cancer Society, Reading Is Fundamental, National Diaper Bank Network, NAMI, and


The Disabled American Veterans (DAV). Visit: SinclairCares.com
